concepts.name: Skybreak
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset: a premium mobile adventure game's text-free square Play Store app icon, full bleed edge to edge, no rounded corners, no border, no mockup, no lettering. This is a NEW authored icon, not a layout of the supplied sprite. The reference is identity guidance only: Pip is a round yellow bird with a cream belly, enormous white eyes with dark teal pupils, a coral-orange beak and three jaunty crest feathers. Preserve those recognizable traits but completely re-pose and upgrade the art. The game is a playful bird courier adventure across floating islands and world regions, collecting stars and fighting cartoon bosses; exercise is only a side mode. The result must be compelling at 48px: one dominant silhouette, bold values, eyes readable, no tiny clutter, premium game key-art finish, generous corner-mask safety for eyes/beak. Do not imitate another known game mascot. Direction: SKYBREAK. Pip is banking sharply toward the viewer, cheeky determined grin, one wing sweeping toward the lower-left foreground, crest swept by speed. Big expressive eyes and coral beak occupy the middle. A thick curved gold star trail sweeps behind him, and just two broken chunks of a turquoise garden gateway imply he's bursting into an adventure. Extreme charming foreshortening, energetic upward diagonal, silhouette occupies 80 percent of the square. Art direction: exquisitely drawn 2.5D hand-painted cel animation, restrained confident dark-teal contour, tactile gouache light on buttery golden feathers, warm sun glow on top-right edges, rich deep petrol/teal shadows and luminous cyan sky opening. Saturated but disciplined complementary teal/coral/gold palette. High-end, bold, funny and adventurous. Sparse background with depth, not a busy landscape. No stars on forehead, no clothes, no text.

Keep Pip's anatomy compact and recognizably birdlike, no hands, no costume. One bird, one envelope. No text.

menu: Use case: logo-brand. Asset: a professionally art-directed game MENU TITLE WORDMARK on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background, wide landscape composition, no board, no mockup, no app icon. Text, exactly: BEAKBOUND. One readable word, B E A K B O U N D. It is a working title for a joyful bird courier adventure through floating islands and cartoon boss battles. The supplied image is a supporting STYLE REFERENCE only, not an edit target: match its warm golden/coral character, polished illustrated 3D depth and charming game energy. Design bespoke ultra-bold chunky slightly irregular lettering, with a rising arch and tightly considered spacing. Butter-yellow/golden top faces, creamy sunlit edges, rich coral-orange extruded sides, a strong clean deep-teal outer silhouette and thin warm cream keyline. The first B has a very subtle feather-shaped flourish and the final D lifts into a tiny upward wing tip. An elegant sky-blue flight swoosh runs UNDER the baseline, terminating in one small gold star. Custom letterforms, expressive rhythm and premium hand-painted cel shading; sharp, readable, beautiful as a game title, playful but not babyish. The WORD is the hero, no character face, no extra tagline, no secondary wording, no scene or rectangular backing, no checkerboard painted into art, no grass or buildings. Fill the wide canvas comfortably with the wordmark, leaving a modest clear transparent margin. Render as a usable isolated high-resolution transparent logo, ideally 1536 pixels wide or more.
export_notes: Unchanged generated masters preserved. Store exports resized to 512 square, with transparent pixels flattened onto the direction background; smaller previews are 64, 48, and 32 pixels. Menu logo retains transparency.
